title: scilla autumnalis subsp. fallax
intro: Scilla autumnalis subsp. fallax, commonly known as autumn-flowering glory-of-the-snow, is a bulbous perennial plant in the family Asparagaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, lower blood pressure, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Scilla autumnalis subsp. fallax include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
